Host apps in Shiny

Show MCP Apps, from this process or any MCP server, in a shinychat conversation or a pane of a Shiny app.

Host MCP Apps in a shinychat conversation

Serving a Shiny app as it is

For serving an existing Shiny app live, until Shiny’s own MCP support is released. Outside an MCP App, the helpers for server functions do nothing, so the app still runs as usual.

as_mcp_app()
Serve a Shiny app as an MCP App
bindMcp()
Choose what the model sees of a Shiny app
mcp_model_context() mcp_send_message() is_mcp_session()
Talk to the model from a Shiny app served with shinymcp

The chat client around a Shiny app served with shinymcp
